title: Boundary walls on up to two lot boundaries, R20-R25
text: C3.4.4 Boundary walls may be built in accordance with Table 3.4c provided: i. boundary walls are located behind the street setback; ii. overshadowing does not exceed the limits of C3.8.1; and iii. they are finished to an equivalent standard to the rest of the development, to the satisfaction of the decision-maker. Table 3.4c Lot boundary setbacks, number of boundaries: R20 - R25 Two.
notes: from: ch3 C3.4.4#count-r20-r25. Table 3.4c (p34) values unchanged from Chapter 3; the clause text now cites C3.8.1 for overshadowing. Two boundaries (Table 3.4c).
